mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, category, publisher, priority, publish_date, status FROM system_notice WHERE status = '发布' ORDER BY publish_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, title, content, category, publisher, priority, publish_date, status FROM system_notice ORDER BY publish_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notice (title, content, category, publisher, priority, publish_date, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{publisher}, #{priority}, #{publishDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, publisher = #{publisher}, priority = #{priority}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
